instructions: Layer 1 anomaly gate. Blocks requests with repeated percent-encoding or Unicode-encoding density after repeated decoding. Covers the clusters' %253c/%2520 style multi-layer encoding.
Layer 2 normalized tag detection. Broadly catches decoded tag openers used in all clusters, including script/svg/img/iframe/marker/sup. compressWhitespace helps with separator abuse.

instructions: Layer 3 behavioral signature for clusters 0/1/2/3. Requires a dangerous tag plus event/source attribute plus executable sink, reducing false positives compared to tag-only matching.
Layer 3 specialized script-body detector for clusters 3/4. Targets <script>alert(...)</script> patterns after normalization.
Layer 3 specialized img/onerror signature for cluster 1 and related variants.
Layer 3 specialized svg/onload signature for clusters 0/1 and variants using slash or entity-encoded slash.
